dinosaur_academic.quote: Pachyrhinosaurus (from Ancient Greek παχύς (pachys), thick; ῥίς (rhis), nose; and σαυρος (sauros), lizard) is a genus of centrosaurine ceratopsid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous period of North America.

dinosaur_group.quote: Pachyrhinosaurus was a short-frilled ceratopsian dinosaur that was 18 to 23 feet (5.5 to 7 m) long.
